purpose: After Phases A and B, decide whether Group 5 closes. The closure question is intentionally practical: is the current learning subsystem sufficiently demonstrated to remain as a BOUNDED SUPPORTING CAPABILITY of Genesis? NOT: is autonomous organizational learning solved? NOT: is the Academy complete as a research program?

phaseAResult.strongestOutcome: Mission B demonstrated active causal generalization: a pattern learned from solar/wind/database/renewable-energy comparison missions transferred to a NOVEL content domain (note-taking-app evaluation for academic researchers) and causally collapsed a 2-specialist baseline into a 1-Sole-Operator learned organization while preserving mission correctness. This is the strongest generalization evidence possible under scripted reasoning conditions.
phaseAResult.boundaryObservation: Mission A (Rust vs Go) correctly produced NON_APPLICABLE because the v0.1 GoalCompiler classified the goal as software-engineering (signals 'service', 'code') — no trusted pattern matched. Genesis correctly did NOT apply learned knowledge where its applicability context does not match. Together, Missions A and B demonstrate Genesis can distinguish content similarity from organizational applicability.

phaseBResult.organizationShape: 2 workers (Software Engineer + Documentation Writer), software-engineering domain, scope='standard' (multi-step + 'test' signal)

criteria.capability: Distinguish at least some comparable from non-comparable evidence
criteria.evidence: G5-04A Semantic Integrity: discovered and remediated the false-aggregation case where C001-01 (solar-vs-wind research) and C001-07 (document comparison) were grouped by coarse domain='research' alone. Introduced Evidence Signature v1 (domain + sorted capabilityNeeds). Tests in tests/learning/semantic-integrity.test.ts enforce: (a) the quarantined candidate ID is NOT produced under new semantics; (b) same-signature experiences aggregate; (c) different-signature experiences do NOT aggregate as contradictions.

StatisticalCandidateGenerator produced 4 candidates in Cohort 001 (under old semantics, 1 was contaminated), 7 candidates in Cohort 002 (under new semantics). Candidate kinds include prefer-role and avoid-role, both first-class.

RuleCandidateEvaluator promotes candidates with support ≥ 2 + no contradictions + verification quality success-or-mixed. G5-05 promoted 3 trusted patterns; 4 remained tentative (support=1); 0 rejected. Quarantine mechanism (G5-04A) preserves historical evidence while preventing contaminated patterns from influencing future planning.

criteria.evidence: RulePatternRetriever matches domain (exact) + capabilityNeeds (intersection). G5-06 phase A confirmed retrieval: pattern was retrieved and passed to planner. G5-07 confirmed retrieval on 3 of 4 unseen missions. G5-08 phase A mission B confirmed retrieval on a NOVEL content domain.

criteria.capability: Let learned knowledge causally influence organization
criteria.evidence: G5-06 phase A: prefer-role for Sole Operator collapsed 2 specialists → 1 Sole Operator (workerCount 2→1, roles [Web Researcher, Report Writer] → [Sole Operator]). G5-06 phase B: same causal effect on a different mission (renewable-energy comparison). G5-08 phase A mission B: same causal effect on a NOVEL content domain (note-taking-app evaluation). The causal mechanism is now part of production behavior in src/organization/organization-planner.ts (lines 527-573).

G5-07: 1 of 4 sealed missions correctly produced NON_APPLICABLE (C001-06 software-engineering; no trusted pattern matched). G5-08 phase A mission A: same NON_APPLICABLE on a software-engineering mission (Rust vs Go). G5-08 phase B Greenfield: NON_APPLICABLE on a software-engineering mission (CLI tool). Genesis correctly does NOT apply learned knowledge where its applicability context does not match — three independent observations across G5-07 and G5-08.

criteria.capability: Carry learned knowledge across an unseen mission boundary
criteria.evidence: G5-07: 3 of 4 sealed Cohort 001 transfer missions produced CONFIRMATORY_TRANSFER (pattern retrieved, baseline already satisfied preference). G5-08 phase A mission B: GENERALIZATION_ACTIVE — pattern transferred to a NOVEL content domain and causally changed organization. The unseen-mission boundary is crossed correctly: pattern reaches missions that did NOT participate in learning.

criteria.capability: Execute a fresh end-to-end Genesis mission without learning corrupting current mission truth
criteria.evidence: G5-08 phase B Greenfield: Genesis executed Goal → Requirements → Organization (emerged, not hand-designed) → Genomes → Worker → Execution → Independent Verification, all PASS. No false success. No evaluator/gold leakage. Learned patterns did not override stronger current requirements (none applied). Independent runtime verification confirms artifacts actually function. Mission truth preserved.

closureClassification.rationale: All 9 capability criteria are supported by evidence. The strongest generalization evidence (G5-08 phase A mission B) demonstrates active causal transfer to a novel content domain under scripted reasoning. However, important evidence limitations remain: (a) all missions used scripted reasoning (provenance.source = synthetic), so behavioral generalization to real LLM workers is not tested; (b) only prefer-role: Sole Operator is implemented (specialist prefer-role is unimplemented); (c) the architecture cannot represent organizational requirements (only capability needs); (d) the v0.1 GoalCompiler uses word-boundary heuristics that occasionally misclassify domains (e.g., Rust-vs-Go as software-engineering rather than research); (e) N remains small (4 sealed + 2 generalization + 1 greenfield = 7 transfer/generalization missions total). These limitations do not prevent Group 5 from closing — they are recorded as future work and do not represent material defects that would make learning unsafe as a bounded supporting capability.

alternativeConsidered.CLOSED_PASS: Rejected because the scripted-reasoning limitation is material — claims about real-LLM behavioral generalization cannot be made.
alternativeConsidered.NOT_READY: Rejected because no material defect prevents treating learning as a safe supporting capability. The 9 criteria are all supported.
alternativeConsidered.DESIGN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Rejected because no fundamental architectural issue was exposed. The architecture's limitations (organizational requirements, specialist prefer-role) are documented future work, not blocking defects.
